1970.notes: Long-form schedule of N.D.C.C. 57-38-29 as amended by 1961 S.L. ch. 359 sec. 5 (H.B. 908), in force through tax year 1972: the later rate changes (1963 S.L. ch. 395 and 1965 S.L. ch. 386) were disapproved by referendum (July 17, 1963 and Sept. 21, 1965, per the referred-measures records printed with the 1965 and 1967 session laws on ndlegis.gov) and the 1967, 1969 and 1971 session laws did not amend 57-38-29; replaced by 1973 S.L. ch. 465 from 1973. Same schedule for all filing statuses (spouses could file separate returns). Deduction not recorded: North Dakota personal exemptions / standard deduction for 1970-72 not verified in an allowed source. Federal income tax deductibility not modelled. A 'Vietnam bonus surtax' (57-38-30.2: 1% of taxable income, minimum $2.50, maximum $12.50, as amended by 1973 S.L. ch. 471) existed by 1973 and may have applied in some of these years; not modelled.
